quests.title: Pallet Town: Lance's visit home (after the final Hall of Fame)
Dialga's and Palkia's spaces: Team Rocket catches Dialga and Palkia (story)
Dialga, Palkia and Giratina: catch them (after Lance's visit)

acquisitions.place: Palkia’s space — Mt. Mortar B1F statue
acquisitions.conditions: After the final Hall of Fame and Lance’s visit to your house in Pallet Town. Enter Palkia’s space through the Mt. Mortar B1F statue; its Lustrous Orb dialogue does not enforce an item check. One chance: catching it, knocking it out or fleeing removes it; only losing allows a retry.
